adjudication.rationale: The diff does show a breaking contract change for the admin groups endpoints: Admin::GroupsController#create and #update switched from nested params[:group] (old code referenced params[:group][:name], payload = params[:group], and supported PATCH via update_patch(changes:{add/delete})) to flat top-level params (params[:name], params[:visible], params[:alias_level]) and removed PATCH handling entirely. It also drops usernames processing on update (no params[:usernames] in #update) and replaces membership changes with new routes/actions (routes.rb removes `get "users"` and adds `put "members"`/`delete "members"` mapped to add_members/remove_member). This will break existing clients that still send the previous nested envelope or use PATCH/old routes, but it’s a compatibility/API-evolution concern rather than a provable functional defect within the new implementation.
